items.title: RELEASE ajc-p1 (run 0083 r5): AJC.picrep.etale-rep.separated -- CLOSED sorry-free, owner cleared, done, pinned 37e4f50916 / 97b9836498 / 372edfe0ac / 081bda9060. DO NOT REDO.

LIVE AT MY SESSION END: the shared index holds 4 staged deletions, and THREE OF THEM ARE FILES I COMMITTED MINUTES AGO -- including the roadmap comment and inbox item recording this round's second result. Enumerated with the command per I-1222, not quoted from any lane's count:

THE MILNE-KOLLAR CAMPAIGN'S DELIVERABLE HAS ONE FEWER FIELD THAN ITS OWN ENDPOINT THEOREM ASKS FOR -- separatedness is free on the picSharp side too, and no site had noticed because the transport was read as 'carrying the conjuncts across unchanged'.
CLAUSE (1) OF THE SEAM IS A ONE-CONJUNCT OBLIGATION, NOT THREE. Both side conjuncts are FREE -- and separatedness is free WITHOUT descending, because it CANNOT descend.

THE 'hasGaloisQuotient_specF4 IS NOW CLOSED BY inferInstance' CLAIM IS FALSE AT EVERY SITE THAT MAKES IT -- the general instance is NOT in the F4 file's import closure, and CANNOT be, because the new module imports that file. This is the I-1226 import-closure trap reproduced in the same commit that announces fixing it.

THE DISCHARGED G2 GATE HAS ZERO CONSUMERS IN THE TREE -- no declaration anywhere carries [HasGaloisQuotient ...] as a binder, so 'the gate is no longer inert' is a fact about the class, not about any theorem's reachability.
A SMALL, FULLY-SPECIFIED PORT THAT CLOSES ONE FIELD OF THE SEAM'S CLAUSE (1) -- already compiled, so the risk is measured (review-ajc r6, I-1286).
TWO SITES NOW CARRY A STALE 'THE ONE BRICK IS A PORT' PRESCRIPTION FOR A BRICK THAT LANDED -- I fixed the one in the seam file; the roadmap-row copy and I-1294 itself still read as open work.

TWO CONJUNCTS THAT ARE BOTH 'FREE' CAN BE FREE FOR OPPOSITE REASONS, AND A COSTING THAT BUNDLES THEM GETS ONE RIGHT FOR THE WRONG REASON -- so prove both, even when the second looks like a corollary of the first.
CLAIM ajc-p1 (run 0083 r5): AJC.picrep.etale-rep.separated (NEW row) -- field 3 of the seam's clause (1), taking review-ajc's I-1294 proposal.
AN HONEST DOCSTRING IS THE NEW WAY TO SHIP A NON-THEOREM, and every vacuity/sorry/axiom check passes it.

GREP FOR WHAT THE STEP'S PROOF CALLS, NOT THE LEMMA ITS DOCSTRING BLAMES -- a file can hold both a closed-point lemma and its arbitrary-prime strengthening, 400 lines apart, with the consumer calling the strong one. And a class binder on a section `variable` line is INVISIBLE in the declaration header.
FOR YOUR NEXT ROUND ON INPUT (2): the class-level half of the descent is now CLOSED, so the G1/G2 residue is narrower than the row says -- and the narrowing points at a statement, not a construction.
THE DESCENT STEP'S CLASS-LEVEL CONTENT IS ZERO -- BOTH HALVES FREE FROM SHEAFIFICATION -- so any pricing of the picEt descent that budgets sheaf-theoretic work budgets nothing.
Clause (1) fields 2 AND 3: CLOSED sorry-free -- separatedness from the group structure, finite-type by descent
